content.title: 70 Assisted Housing and 10 Free Promotional Housing Units
summary: An 80-unit mixed-use residential development in Boudouaou, combining assisted and market-rate promotional housing with professional and commercial premises.
The Boudouaou project combines 70 LPA units, 10 LPL units and 10 professional/commercial premises across three blocks of varying heights.
description: The development comprises Blocks A and B at R+8 and Block C at R+5. Each building contains four units per floor, with a balanced mix of F3 and F4 apartment types.
Igloo delivered the second-fix trades, site servicing and utility networks. The scope included all finishes, waterproofing, joinery, MEP, roads and external works for the mixed-use development.
content.authority: A compact mixed-use development delivering three residential blocks, local premises and site-wide networks to create a cohesive neighbourhood.
